intro: Prestique builds custom AI voice and text agents for small businesses. Where Phorest offers an API, Prestique connects the agent to it so it can work from the same information your team sees and create records there, within what that API allows.
You keep Phorest. The agent works with it rather than replacing it. You control what the agent says and does, and changes are made when you ask for them.
